disc.title: Information
disc.body: Pet Aura reveals your pet's world: its aura, horoscope and the energies of its space. It does not replace a veterinary examination – if you are worried about your pet, see a vet.
home.empty: Photograph your pet to reveal their aura
tip.red: The red in the background is rattling the root chakra. Swap it for something earthy, like a brown or green blanket.
tip.yellow: Lots of yellow, lots of sparkle. Keep a calm corner nearby so the energy can settle.
tip.green: Green is lifting the heart chakra. Keep a plant, or a green cushion, near the favourite nap spot.
tip.blue: Blue brings calm. A soft blue blanket in the north corner keeps it flowing.
tip.purple: Purple stirs the third eye. A tidy, quiet window spot suits this mood.
tip.neutral: A balanced backdrop. Try a green cushion in the north corner for a little extra grounding.
el.fire: Fire energy: bold and restless today. Plan a playful run to burn it off.
el.earth: Earth energy: steady and food-minded. A calm walk suits the day.
el.air: Air energy: curious and chatty. New smells and a puzzle toy will delight.
el.water: Water energy: soft and cuddly. Plenty of quiet time together.

au.start.title: AURA SCANNER
au.start.p1: Your pet's face and both eyes should be clearly visible.
au.start.p2: Choose a sitting or standing pose if possible.
au.start.p3: The head should face the camera.
au.start.p4: Make sure there is enough natural light.
au.start.p5: Both the head and the chest should fit in the picture.
au.start.dog: For dogs: a sitting or standing three-quarter portrait, head turned toward the camera.
au.start.cat: For cats: a sitting or sphinx pose, with the face and ears clearly visible.
au.start.ok: The photo doesn't have to be perfect! What matters is that your pet is clearly visible.
au.start.galnote: With a gallery photo, the aura is born from the symbolic meeting of the astrological core and the body language seen in the picture.

au.fail.title: THE MIRROR IS STILL SILENT
au.fail.sub: The lights have stayed hidden for now
au.fail.h: {name}'s aura is still hiding behind a veil.
au.fail.p: The magic mirror needs clear light to read the colors of your pet's soul. Take a new, brighter photo in which {name}'s eyes shine clearly!
au.fail.tip.arc: A little magic: have your pet face you, with both eyes looking into the lens.
au.fail.tip.homalyos: A little magic: hold the phone still for a moment, and wait until your pet settles too.
au.fail.tip.sotet: A little magic: find a window – in daylight the mirror sees much more clearly.
au.fail.tip.tavol: A little magic: step closer, so your pet's head and chest fill the circle.
au.fail.note: This attempt does not count toward your readings.
au.res.title: AURA PORTRAIT
au.res.vet: If you are worried about your pet, see a vet.
au.res.sample2: {name}'s aura now carries the depth of water and the freshness of a forward-looking gaze. A quiet curiosity glows within.
au.res.sample3: Three lights meet in {name}'s aura right now. The astrological core gives a warm, golden foundation that brings both momentum and calm. The energy arriving from the space carries the freshness of renewal into the moment. The forward-looking gaze binds all this with curious openness: {name} is turning toward the world now, and watching. This is their own unique glow today.
